name.description: Display name; leading and trailing whitespace is removed.

email.description:
Sign-in email; trimmed and lowercased. Must not belong to
another user (case-insensitive). Changing it needs a login
session (not a personal access token) and either
`currentPassword` or, for an account without a password
(OIDC/Apple only), a sign-in on this session in the last
10 minutes. Sending the unchanged address needs neither.

currentPassword.description: Your current password — required to change `email` on an account that has one. Never stored or returned.

avatarUrl.description:
An `/uploads/...` path previously returned by the upload
endpoint. Arbitrary external URLs are rejected. `null`
clears the avatar.

pushOnStory.description: Opt-in push for other members' new stories (push only, off by default).

pushOnGiftList.description: Push for gift lists — being added, the Secret Santa draw, and wishes added by the person you're buying for (push only, on by default).
